**How to submit:** Write your answers in a document or on paper. Upload the file or a clear photo to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 10**.
No task needs AI.

Choose a free mobile game. Play one level for about five minutes, first
with headphones, then on the phone speaker.

## Task 1 · Evaluate (3 marks)

a) Write the name of the game and the level. Score its audio with the seven
criteria (1–3), with one note of evidence (a moment) for each. (2 marks)

{{< answer-space lines=8 >}}

b) Which criterion is the weakest? What did you notice on the phone speaker
that you did not notice with headphones? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

## Task 2 · Feedback (2 marks)

Write two pieces of feedback for the sound designer of this game, each in
three parts: **I hear …**, **it matters because …**, **try …**.

{{< answer-space lines=6 >}}
